items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the coach looked at me and said, “Oh, no. You’re too small.”

ctx.x: So, I said, “Don’t, don’t hug her.” So, the next thing I knew, I was drafted. I deliberately let the Army draft me. I say deliberately because I’d enrolled in the—I just had to play football with the Morgan Bears. Morgan had the reputation, like Brandon, of state winners and whatever. I just wanted to be associated with a team of blacks that was doing something important. Sure enough, I made this discreet by—in the football team, the coach looked at me and said, “Oh, no. You’re too small.” I was 5’ 6” and only…
